request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Sigilspine Porcupine".

Creative brief
Name: Sigilspine Porcupine
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A rotating artillery creature whose quills lock into magical formations.
Body and silhouette: Round low mammal with a pointed face, short legs, and a large fan of oversized quills.
Signature features: Rune-marked quills, glowing back ring, and crystal nose.
Palette and materials: Dark plum, pale ivory, deep navy, and magenta light.
Movement personality: Defensive, twitchy, and increasingly agitated.
Attack concept: Raises six large quills and launches them sequentially around a rotating compass pattern.
Directional details: One black quill remains permanently attached above the right hip.
Avoid: Cute hedgehog, dozens of tiny quills, uncontrolled full-screen barrage.
